purpose: one current all-symbol rejection-first screen for whether a two-leg Binance Spot route is cheaper than a direct pair for an independently required organic asset conversion

source_boundary.contemporaneous_title: Network-Based Path Optimization for High-Frequency Cryptocurrency Arbitrage: Empirical Evidence
source_boundary.contemporaneous_abstract_scope: January through December 2025 Binance data across 64 trading-pair groups; within-exchange alternative paths under conservative all-taker fees and slippage; the abstract says optimized risk-adjusted performance beats a baseline but does not prove absolute current profit
source_boundary.prior_empirical_finding: historical Binance indirect internal conversions changed an already-intended A-to-B conversion through one intermediary and averaged 14.4 bips better than the direct conversion, while ordinary triangular arbitrage was rare and fee-constrained

universe.venue: Binance Spot mainnet public market data
universe.directed_edges: every current TRADING spot symbol with MARKET order support and a positive MARKET_LOT_SIZE step or positive LOT_SIZE fallback
universe.routes: every ordered source-to-target direct edge with exactly one distinct intermediary and both indirect edges available
universe.valuation_scope: source intermediary and target must each have a current direct executable conversion to USDT; USDT values itself at one
universe.selection_rule: complete rule-defined population before book outcomes with no asset symbol or route chosen from results

capture.book_endpoint: GET https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/bookTicker for every current symbol in one response
capture.retry_policy: none after any retained successful response; transport failure rejects the run rather than changing the contract
capture.raw_evidence: write and hash each untouched response before parsing and append fsynced request receipts and top-ten derived rows
capture.one_use_rule: do not alter assets routes sizes fees stress thresholds or sample ordering after first book access and do not rerun an unchanged mechanism

execution_model.direct_route: one immediate taker leg at displayed top of book
execution_model.indirect_route: two sequential immediate taker legs at displayed top of book with no atomicity or fill claim
execution_model.fee_semantics: deduct fee from each leg output; direct pays once and indirect pays twice; this is a public VIP-0 feasibility gate rather than same-account fee proof
execution_model.quantity_rounding: floor every submitted base quantity to positive MARKET_LOT_SIZE step otherwise positive LOT_SIZE step
execution_model.capacity: direct and both indirect legs must fit displayed top quantity
execution_model.residuals: retain source and intermediary residuals and value them through the same conservative direct-to-USDT side after one taker fee
execution_model.savings_definition: indirect ending USDT-equivalent total value divided by direct ending USDT-equivalent total value minus one, less three bips stress
execution_model.synchronization_caveat: one HTTP response does not expose per-symbol source timestamps and sequential indirect execution is non-atomic

empirical_candidate_requires_for_one_rou: all 60 scheduled samples are valid and the capture lasts at least 116000 milliseconds
every public request completes within 1500 milliseconds
direct and both indirect legs fit displayed top quantity in all 60 samples
positive savings after exact rounding conservative fees residual valuation and three-bip stress in at least 48 of 60 samples
at least 12 positive samples in each consecutive 15-sample block
positive median stressed savings across all 60 samples
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: an independently required organic source-to-target conversion with no generated volume
same-account exact commissions discounts tax and special rates for all involved symbols
independent non-overlapping current windows across market and liquidity regimes
prospective paper or owned authorized execution proving sequential completion latency slippage residuals and realized savings
inventory opportunity custody tax and failure-unwind costs
fail-closed route comparison immediately before every independently justified conversion
acceptance_boundary.missing_additional_evidence_action: retain as research-only candidate and keep accepted_edge false

prohibited_shortcuts: calling route savings standalone arbitrage or profit without an organic conversion
creating rerouting splitting or wash volume to obtain a measured saving rebate or tier
treating a historical 14.4-bip average or better risk-adjusted performance as current absolute profit
using public VIP-0 fees as exact account fees
ignoring lot rounding top-level capacity residuals extra-leg latency adverse selection or partial completion
calling a two-minute public screen stable profitable accepted or deployment-ready
adaptively rerunning only favorable routes or weakening fees stress or recurrence gates
